specs.scene: An overhead flat-lay of a clinic intake counter, positively blank appointment forms and blank certificate sheets fanned across the surface, a stethoscope coiled beside a stack of blank intake folders, a single blank name badge, a slim tuition envelope, a small ceramic mug, and a roll of blank sticky notes pressed close to all four edges and overlapping, two hands entering from the bottom edge arranging the folders into a short row, bare patches of counter left between the clusters.
specs.source_quote: Her current cohort has one enrollee

recognisable.why: A clinic intake counter with a stethoscope and forms is an immediately familiar trade setting even without reading anything.

legibility.why: Dense flat-lay texture is not meant to be individually resolved, so it still reads as one focal mass.

curiosity.why: 'Room of one, still running' implies an open trajectory the viewer wants resolved but does not state it.

subject.why: The clutter of overlapping small objects gives no single clear anchor the eye lands on first.

credible.why: No figure is carried, which scores full by rubric.

stakes.why: Implies the operator's real risk of staying stuck at one paying client.

reexpress.why: Reframes the title's 'one enrollee' through the script's own room metaphor rather than repeating it verbatim.

specs.scene: A documentary photograph of an empty lecture hall, rows of vacant seats fading into shadow toward the back wall, a single spotlit lectern standing at the front of the room, no people, no visible text or signage anywhere in frame.
specs.source_quote: The venture lane for this business just closed at the top

recognisable.why: An empty lecture hall with a lectern is a familiar scene even to a cold viewer, though not a named brand.

legibility.why: The lectern is the only element requiring resolution; the seats behind it are background texture.

curiosity.why: A flat editorial verdict with no explanation of why scale led to an exit is the register's core curiosity move.

subject.why: The lit lectern is a single distinctive object anchor in an otherwise empty room.

credible.why: No figure is carried, which scores full.

stakes.why: Implies a real fork for any operator building the same model: scale toward acquisition or stay small.

reexpress.why: Restates the title's claim as a sharper standalone verdict rather than repeating its wording.

specs.scene: A single unbranded folding chair positioned alone in the center of an otherwise empty small classroom, pale walls, a faint rectangle of daylight from an unseen window, the chair filling most of the frame, no people, no visible text.
specs.source_quote: cohorts under six people stop feeling like a room

recognisable.why: A folding chair in an empty classroom is an everyday object anyone recognizes instantly.

legibility.why: One object, one empty room, nothing else to resolve.

curiosity.why: 'Barely a room' is an unexplained verdict that makes the viewer want to know the threshold.

subject.why: The single chair is the textbook clear object anchor the rubric rewards.

credible.why: No figure is carried, which scores full.

stakes.why: Directly threatens any viewer running a small cohort: fall under the seat count and the product itself degrades.

reexpress.why: Uses the script's own room metaphor to carry the consequence, leaving the title to carry the six-person mechanism.

specs.scene: A single card reader payment terminal resting flat on a plain countertop, small screen facing up but blank, cable coiled neatly beside it, no branding, no hands, no other objects in frame.
specs.source_quote: the platform fee alone is around fifteen hundred dollars

recognisable.why: A card reader terminal is an everyday, instantly recognizable object regardless of brand.

legibility.why: One product, plainly shown, nothing competing for attention.

curiosity.why: The line states a loss outright rather than posing an unresolved verdict, so it mostly informs rather than provokes.

subject.why: The terminal is a single, distinctive, mass-market object anchor.

credible.why: The figure matches the script's own smallest honest unit exactly, which a sceptical operator would believe without proof.

stakes.why: A direct, recurring money-lost stake for anyone running the same kind of cohort.

reexpress.why: Converts the script's fee mention into a concrete per-cohort loss the title never states, splitting the work cleanly.
